questions.question: Mathura was the second capital of ________ dynasty.
questions.solution:
• Second Capital: Kushana
  • Fact: While Purushapura (Peshawar) was the main capital, Mathura served as the second capital and a major center for art and religion under the Kushanas.

questions.question: Who among the following was the first Home Minister of Independent India?
questions.solution:
• First Home Minister: Sardar Vallabh Bhai Patel
  • Context: Known as the 'Iron Man of India,' Sardar Patel played a pivotal role in the political integration of over 500 princely states into the Indian Union.

questions.question:
Select the option that is true regarding the following two statements labelled Assertion (A) and Reason (R).

A. The first battle of Panipat was one of the decisive battles of India.

R. It brought into power a new band of invaders called Mughals.
questions.option_1: A is true, but R is false.
questions.option_2: Statements A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A.
questions.option_3: R is true, but A is false.
questions.option_4: Statements A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A.
questions.solution:
• Panipat Analysis: Statements A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A.
  • History: The First Battle of Panipat (1526) was decisive because Babur's victory over Ibrahim Lodi marked the end of the Delhi Sultanate and the foundation of the Mughal Empire.

questions.question: Who was the first sultan (in the recorded history of the Dargah Sharif) to visit the shrine of khwaja Muinuddin Chisti?
questions.solution:
• Ajmer Sharif Visit: Muhammad bin Tughluq
  • Detail: Muhammad bin Tughluq is recorded as the first Sultan of Delhi to make a pilgrimage to the shrine of Khwaja Muinuddin Chishti in Ajmer.

questions.question: In which of the following years did Mahatma Gandhi lead the Satyagraha and hunger strike for the first time in India?
questions.solution:
• First Hunger Strike: 1918
  • Event: During the Ahmedabad Mill Strike of 1918, Gandhi used a hunger strike for the first time in India to support the workers' demand for a 35% wage hike.

questions.question: The Kushan emperor Kanishka, who ruled from the late first to the early/mid-second century AD was the ____________ Kushan ruler.
questions.solution:
• Kanishka's Order: third
  • Dynasty: Kanishka I was the third great Kushan emperor, following Kujula Kadphises (founder) and Vima Kadphises.

questions.question:
Match the books in List 1 with their authors in List 2.

List 1 List 2

A. The Philosophy of the Bomb 1. Sachindranath Sanyal

B. Bandi Jiwan 2. Bankim Chandra Chattopadhyay

C. Pather Dabi 3. Bhagwati Charan Vohra

D. Anandmath 4. Sarat Chandra Chattopadhyay
questions.solution:
• Book Match: A-3, B-1, C-4, D-2
  • Reference: The Philosophy of the Bomb (Vohra), Bandi Jiwan (Sanyal), Pather Dabi (S.C. Chattopadhyay), and Anandmath (B.C. Chattopadhyay).
